stemMd: A data set has 12 observations with mean 15. Two observations, 8 and 10, are removed. What is the mean of the remaining observations?
explanationMd: The original total is 180. Removing 18 leaves 162 across 10 observations, giving 16.2. Removing below-average values raises the mean, which checks the direction.

distractorRationale.b: This does not use the correct total and count.
distractorRationale.e: This is the removed total, not the remaining mean.
distractorRationale.a: This divides the remaining total by the original count.
distractorRationale.c: The removed values are below the original mean, so the mean rises.
